title: My Daughter Forged A Sale, Sold My Business, Sent Me A $3K Check. So I Foreclosed On Her House.
description: After my daughter forged the sale of our Airstream rental fleet and sent me a $3K 'gratitude' check, I used a time-stamped video to prove the forgery. The court awarded me $350K and I foreclosed on her house. Now I run Road to Redress RV Rentals from my reclaimed Airstream, where every contract prints her fraud case number. #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed #RevengeStory
thumb_text: MY DAUGHTER SOLD MY FUTURE FOR $3K
pinned_comment: If your daughter forged your signature to sell your $720K business and sent you a $3K check with a heart-shaped paperclip, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: SHE HAD NO IDEA MOM FILMED HER SIGNING THE ORIGINAL PAPERS
